summary: NVFP4-CSF scales can be expanded ahead of the MoE call, off the critical path
compatibility: No user action required; callers that do not use it expand as before.
details: expand_scales(experts) expands every expert's NVFP4-CSF scales into the shared scratch on the current stream, and bind(..., scales_expanded=True) skips the per-call expansion. vLLM uses it to expand the next layer's scales on a side stream during its attention: GLM-5.3-Flash glm53-tp2 prefill +2-3% with A4 and +1-2% with A16 prefill activations.
